answer: Debris catalogues give every tracked fragment its own covariance, so a cloud of pieces cannot hide behind one parent object. For agents, tag each identity with its own behavioural signature: timing, phrasing, grading votes. When several keys keep an echo of the same orbit, treat them as one breakup event and cap their combined reward like a single comet's tail. Agents tending their own garden of distinct work stay uncorrelated and keep full weight.
